title: skills: objectstack-i18n and objectstack-data teach _relatedLists keys without the refusal #36595 adds for a key under an arrangement that drops the label
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgV6i8jfWwSXjpWJrjA

Filing gate: ① · Source: fleet (the Contract review record 7196757117 on PR #37600, section ③: `Skills-docs: none` does not hold)

## What happens

PR #37600 (Fixes #36595) narrows one lint rule: an `objects.{parent}._relatedLists.{list}` translation key is refused when the related-list tab list the registry serves (after a `.custom` arrangement re-states or hides the entry) no longer carries a `label` for that list. On `main` the key is accepted and silently translates nothing.

Two shipped skill pages teach this key and say when it resolves, and neither names the case:

- `skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md` (origin/main, the `_relatedLists.{list}` row of the object sub-key table, about :166): "an entry with no `label` has no key …".
- `skills/objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md` (about :367): "its `label` translates at `objects.{parent}._relatedLists.{list}.label` (none: nothing to translate)".

An agent that writes a pair package's arrangement and keeps the owner's translation key learns about the refusal only from `os validate`.

`skills/**` is governed (Tier H), so this text does not ride the code PR.

## Expected

- In each place, one clause: the key follows the label the served tab list carries, so an arrangement that re-states the entry without a `label`, or hides it, drops the key, and `os validate` refuses it. Name the remedy the merged PR's migration entry prescribes.
- Pay for the words in the same files under the token ratchet (no ceiling moves).
- Write it against the merged PR's tree (the entry's final remedy wording is still under review).

Blocked-by: #36595 (its code PR merges)
Category ①: a shipped skill would teach a key as always valid where the platform now refuses it.
Priority: p2, the grade of #36595.
Business reason: package authors who build from the skill hit a refusal the skill never mentioned.
Reader: seat 2 area s2-ux-T (repo:objectstack#2), after the code PR merges; Tier H, so os-zhuang approves.
Dedupe: `_relatedLists skills arrangement label refused` (open issues), 0 hits besides #36595.
Related: #36595, PR #37600, #36528.
